empty.body: Mukagula kuchokera kwa ogulitsa a Convergeo, ma-order ndi tracking zidzaonekera apa.

escrow.cod: Lipirani mu cash mukalandira order yanu.
escrow.held: Payment yanu ikusungidwa ndi Convergeo mpaka mulandire order yanu.
escrow.refunded: Refund ikubwerera ku mobile money wallet yanu.
escrow.released: Ndalama zatsimikizidwa kwa vendor pambuyo pa fulfilment.

explain.placed: Talandira order yanu ndi kuitumiza kwa seller.
explain.paymentHeld: Ndalama yanu ikusungidwa ndi Convergeo. Seller amalipidwa pambuyo pa delivery basi.
explain.paymentCod: Palibe ndalama yotengedwa. Mumalipira mu cash mukalandira order.
explain.confirmed: Seller wavomereza order yanu ndipo akuikonza.
explain.ready: Order yanu yakonzeka. Onetsani code ya pickup kwa seller mukamatenga.
explain.shipped: Order yanu ili ndi rider. Siyani foni ili on ngati angakuyimbireni.
explain.delivered: Order yanu yafika. Onani zinthu zanu, kenako tsimikizani pansipa.
explain.cancelled: Order iyi yaletsedwa. Lankhulani ndi support ngati simunayembekezere.
explain.refunded: Ndalama yanu ikubwerera ku mobile money wallet yanu.

pickup.title: Zambiri za pickup
pickup.qrLabel: Onetsani QR code iyi kwa vendor
pickup.stubBody: QR ndi PIN ya pickup zidzaonekera apa vendor akamaka order yakonzeka.

dispatch.title: Zosintha za delivery
dispatch.empty: Zambiri za dispatch zidzaonekera apa order yanu ikubwera.

help.title: Mukufuna thandizo pa order iyi?
help.beforeDispatch: Mukufuna kusintha kapena kuletsa? Lankhulani ndi support ndi nambala ya order isanatumizidwe.
help.afterDispatch: Pali vuto ndi order yanu? Lankhulani ndi support ndi nambala ya order.

doorPay.title: Lipirani pa khomo
doorPay.intro: Lipirani {amount} ndi mobile money pamene rider ali pa khomo panu, mutatha kuyang'ana katundu wanu.
doorPay.amountDue: Lipirani {amount} ndi mobile money pa khomo, mutatha kuyang'ana katundu wanu.
doorPay.waitingRider: Batani la kulipira lidzaonekera pano rider akanena kuti wafika.
doorPay.phoneHelp: Pempho lidzapita ku nambala iyi. Manambala a Zamtel sangalandire pakali pano.
doorPay.pending: Onani foni yanu ndipo lowetsani PIN kuti muvomereze malipiro.
doorPay.failed: Malipiro sanadutse. Mungayesenso kapena kugwiritsa ntchito nambala ina.
doorPay.noAttemptsLeft: Palibe mwayi wina. Rider angalandire ndalama za cash, mpaka pa malire.
doorPay.paid: Mwalipira. Khodi yanu yopereka ikuoneka pamwamba. Perekani kwa rider.
doorPay.cash: Lipirani rider {amount} mu cash, kenako mupatseni khodi yanu yopereka.

errors.invalidPhone: Lowetsani nambala ya MTN kapena Airtel ya ku Zambia.
errors.operatorUnsupported: Nambala iyi singalandire pempho. Gwiritsani ntchito nambala ya MTN kapena Airtel.
errors.inFlight: Pempho lili kale pa foni yanu. Vomerezani kapena dikirani pang'ono.
errors.generic: Pali vuto. Onani intaneti yanu ndipo yesaninso.
